wire_format: Little endian. Each 64-byte input: uint32 derivative mode, float32 depth, two seven-float32 SectionTableRow records. Each 28-byte output: area, top width, width slope, conveyance, conveyance slope, momentum factor, momentum slope.
coverage: 240 intervals: linear and cubic Hermite; depth scales 0.0001, 1, 10000; eight seeded interval pairs per scale and mode; five positions including both endpoints. Both original entry points agree on all seven output words.
